notes.title: Patch Notes (1.01)
notes.content:
A patch was released today that addresses the following:

[General]
[list][*]Fixed various script issues.[/list]
[Specific]
[list][*]TEXT: TIP header text sometimes does not fit on screen.
[*]TEXT: TIP "flyers" tab broken in scenario
[*]TEXT: "Flyers" TIP page is blank.
[*]FREEZE: "Tabasco" tip: Leaving TIP page and returning to scenario freezes game. (Minorikawa 14:15)
[*]TEXT: Untranslated text in Osawa's scenario (Osawa 15:45)[/list]
